title: 第二章 李肃劝吕布
slug: 重生之战神吕布全本免费-重生之战神吕布最新章节列表
content_zh:
“那伟恭是来献破敌良策的？”吕布追问道。
“呵呵，今日你我二人相聚，只谈私事，只谈私事。”李肃尴尬的笑道。
“哼，小样，和我斗，你带的什么东西我都知道。”吕布暗道。
古人攀谈感情，一般是同门或者是老乡最亲，两人相聚，自然少不了一番交谈。
“奉先龙虎之姿，来日必成一番功业。”李肃对眼前的吕布心生疑窦，数年前一见，吕布可不是这样的沉稳，莫非是丁原教导有方？
“比不了伟恭啊。”吕布谦虚道。
见左右无人，李肃低声道：“不瞒奉先，我此次前来乃是受太师所托，太师日夜盼望奉先能够弃暗投明，奉先若是投靠太师，必然得到重用。”
“些许金珠，乃是太师的心意，只要奉先能够归附太师，高官厚禄自然是不在话下，太师不久前得一宝马，名为赤兔，乃是日行千里的良驹，只要奉先应允，一并送予。”
“哦，不知此马现在何处？”吕布扫了一眼李肃随从搬上来的两箱金珠。
“此马现在太师营中，夜晚多有不便，只要奉先答应归附太师，赤兔马明日必然送上。”李肃盯着吕布的双眼缓缓说道。
“此事不要再说了，要不是看在你我是同乡的份上，肯定将你拿下交给刺史大人处置了。”吕布正色道，心中微微有些失落，毕竟赤兔马乃是三国第一宝马。
“奉先，良禽择木而栖啊，丁原势必不能长久，三思啊。”李肃顿时急了，来之前可是立了军令状的，这要是无功而返，难免会受到责罚。
“不送，伟恭如果在董卓老贼那待不下去，可来并州。”吕布转身不看李肃。
“唉，奉先，言尽于此了。”李肃喟叹一声，转身离去，不过吕布挽留的话语让他心中一暖。
“真可惜，没见到赤兔马，这董卓也不是傻子啊，还知道分批送。”吕布暗暗惋惜。
“太师，那吕布不识好歹，不愿归附太师，还说来日要……。”太师府邸，李肃满脸惭色的说道。
“哼，等本太师攻破并州军，定要将吕布那厮碎尸万段，以解我心头之恨。”董卓大骂道：“你也是蠢蛋，不仅没有劝降吕布，反而损失了两箱金珠，要你何用，若不是文优相劝，恐怕赤兔马也丢了。”。
“太师饶命，卑职此次前往并州军虽无功，却发现吕布受伤，行动颇为不便。”李肃急忙将自己的发现说了出去。
“吕布受伤？”董卓大笑道：“好，好，此乃天赐良机，没有了吕布，我看丁原小儿如何敌得过本太师手下儿郎。”
“太师，并州兵马精锐，且人数不下于我军，当小心谨慎。”李儒劝道。

“哼，没了吕布，并州军不足为虑，看本太师明日如何杀敌。”董卓不屑的说道。
次日，董卓调集两万精锐，亲自出城督战。
旌旗飘扬，战鼓声声，刀枪如林，铿锵有力的鼓声、衣甲鲜明的将士，让人忍不住热血沸腾，在大军后方的吕布切实体会了一把古代战争的场面，后世的电影与这一比，简直就是小孩子过家家，冷兵器时代，基本上是看不到敌人的战争，哪能有眼前雄壮的画面。
“我乃西凉军上将华雄，谁敢与我一战？”华雄倒提长刀，威风凛凛的站在两军阵前，大声喝道。
“谁敢上前一战？”丁原回头看了一眼身后的将领，却是有些憋屈，没想到吕布刚受伤，这就有人前来叫阵。
阵前斗将，能够极大的激发军队士气，正所谓将是兵之胆，如果将领都畏缩不前，又如何能指望手下的士兵用命呢。
良久，见无人应战，张辽策马挺枪而出“卑职前去斩华雄人头。”
“好，击鼓助威。”丁原大喜。
刚交手，张辽心中就是一沉，华雄的力气比自己大了太多，手臂隐隐有些酸麻，他只能依靠招式的精妙，与华雄周旋，张辽虽然也是名将，与巅峰时期的华雄比，还是有很大差距的。
枪来刀往，尘土飞扬，渐渐的，张辽感觉气力有些不支，而华雄却是一刀比一刀猛，大有一举将其斩杀的势头，此时的张辽毕竟年轻，在战斗经验和力道上比之华雄有着一定的差距。
“拿命来。”华雄大喝一声，使尽全身力气，劈向张辽。

content_en:
"Is Weigong here to present a good strategy to defeat the enemy?" Lu Bu asked.
"Haha, today you and I get together to talk about private matters, only private matters." Li Su smiled awkwardly.
"Huh, little boy, if you fight with me, I know everything you bring." Lu Bu thought to himself.
When people in ancient times talked about their feelings, people from the same family or fellow villagers were usually the closest friends. When two people get together, a conversation is inevitable.
"Following the posture of a dragon and a tiger, I will definitely achieve great achievements in the future." Li Su was suspicious of Lu Bu in front of him. When he met Lu Bu a few years ago, Lu Bu was not so calm. Could it be that Ding Yuan taught him well?
"It can't compare to Wei Gong." Lu Bu said modestly.
Seeing that there was no one around, Li Su said in a low voice: "To be honest with Fengxian, I came here under the entrustment of the Grand Master. The Grand Master hopes Fengxian day and night to abandon the darkness and turn to the light. If Fengxian joins the Grand Master, he will be reused."
"A few gold beads are the Grand Master's wish. As long as Fengxian can join the Grand Master, he will be given a high official and a generous salary. Not long ago, the Grand Master got a horse named Red Rabbit. It is a good horse that can travel thousands of miles. As long as Fengxian agrees, I will give it to him."
"Oh, I wonder where this horse is now?" Lu Bu glanced at the two boxes of gold beads brought up by Li Su's entourage.
"This horse is currently in the Grand Master's camp. It is very inconvenient at night. As long as Feng agrees to join the Grand Master in advance, the red rabbit horse will be delivered tomorrow." Li Su said slowly, staring into Lu Bu's eyes.
"Don't talk about this matter anymore. If it weren't for the fact that you and I are fellow villagers, I would definitely take you down and hand you over to the governor." Lu Bu said seriously, feeling a little disappointed in his heart. After all, the Red Rabbit Horse is the number one horse in the Three Kingdoms.
"Fengxian, good birds choose trees to roost. Ding Yuan will not last long, think twice." Li Su suddenly became anxious. He had issued a military order before coming. If he returned without success, he would inevitably be punished.
"No, if Weigong can't stay with the old thief Dong Zhuo, he can come to Bingzhou." Lu Bu turned away from Li Su.
"Alas, Fengxian, that's all." Li Su sighed, turned around and left, but Lu Bu's words of restraint made him feel warm in his heart.
"It's a pity that I didn't see the red rabbit and horse. Dong Zhuo is not a fool. He even knew how to send them in batches." Lu Bu secretly regretted it.
"Grand Master, that Lu Bu doesn't know what is good or bad. He doesn't want to join the Grand Master. He even said that he would... in the future." Li Su said with a face full of shame at the Grand Master's residence.
"Hmph, when I defeat the Bingzhou army, I will cut Lü Bu's body into thousands of pieces to satisfy the hatred in my heart." Dong Zhuo cursed: "You are also an idiot. Not only did you not persuade Lü Bu to surrender, but you lost two boxes of gold beads. What use do you have? If Wen You hadn't persuaded him, I'm afraid the red rabbit and horse would have been lost."
"Grand Master, spare your life. Although I went to Bingzhou Army this time in vain, I found that Lu Bu was injured and his movements were quite inconvenient." Li Su hurriedly told what he had discovered.
"Lü Bu is injured?" Dong Zhuo laughed and said, "Okay, okay, this is a God-given opportunity. Without Lu Bu, I don't see how Ding Yuan's son can defeat my master's men."
"Grand Master, Bingzhou has elite soldiers and horses, and their number is no less than our army, so be careful." Li Ru advised.
"Hmph, without Lu Bu, the Bingzhou army has nothing to worry about. Let's see how I kill the enemy tomorrow." Dong Zhuo said disdainfully.
The next day, Dong Zhuo mobilized 20,000 elite troops and went out of the city in person to supervise the battle.
The fluttering flags, the sound of war drums, the forest of swords and guns, the sonorous and powerful drums, and the soldiers in bright armor can't help but make people's blood boil. Lu Bu, who was behind the army, experienced the scenes of ancient wars. Compared with this, later movies are like children's play house. In the cold weapon era, you basically can't see the enemy's war, so how can you have the majestic scenes in front of you.
"I am Hua Xiong, the general of the Xiliang Army. Who dares to fight with me?" Hua Xiong raised his sword upside down, stood majestically in front of the two armies, and shouted loudly.
"Who dares to step forward to fight?" Ding Yuan looked back at the general behind him, but he felt a little aggrieved. Unexpectedly, Lu Bu had just been injured, and someone came forward.Come and call the formation.
Fighting generals in front of the formation can greatly stimulate the morale of the army. As the saying goes, a general is the courage of a soldier. If the generals are afraid to move forward, how can they expect the soldiers under them to die?
After a long time, seeing that no one responded, Zhang Liao rode out with a spear and said, "I am humble enough to go and behead Hua Xiong."
"Okay, let's beat the drums and cheer." Ding Yuan was overjoyed.
As soon as they fought, Zhang Liao's heart sank. Hua Xiong was much stronger than him, and his arms were a little sore. He could only rely on the subtlety of his moves to deal with Hua Xiong. Although Zhang Liao was also a famous general, there was still a big gap between him and Hua Xiong at his peak.
The swords were going back and forth, and the dust was flying. Gradually, Zhang Liao felt a little weak in strength, but Hua Xiong's swords were stronger than the last, and he had the momentum to kill him in one fell swoop. After all, Zhang Liao was young at this time, and there was a certain gap between him and Hua Xiong in terms of combat experience and strength.
"Take your life." Hua Xiong shouted and struck Zhang Liao with all his strength.
